component.name: RecGo
component.summary: Screen and webcam recorder for GNOME

description.p: RecGo is a GTK4/Libadwaita screen, window, and webcam recorder with live draggable webcam shapes, drop shadows, hardware encoding (VP9, H.264, H.265, AV1), and GNOME Shell integration.

screenshot.caption: RecGo studio window with calm Libadwaita header, draggable webcam PiP, and transport controls
On-stage countdown overlay before recording begins
Preferences dialog with countdown presets, hardware video encoder selection, and GPU pipeline status

description.p: Release v0.1.5 refreshes the visual identity and standardizes Flatpak AppStream packaging:

ul.li: Redesigned Application Icon: Introduces a pure-vector faceted crystal icon matching the Imladris visual family while preserving RecGo's monitor and red record emblem.
Standardized Application ID: Updates the application ID to io.github.Antux912012.RecGo across D-Bus, GSettings, desktop entry, and Flatpak metadata.
Embedded Flatpak AppStream Screenshots: Composes AppStream XML and icons inside the Flatpak bundle so screenshots and release notes appear in GNOME Software and Discover upon installation.

description.p: Release v0.1.4 redesigns the studio interface for GNOME/Libadwaita HIG compliance and scientist-friendly workflows:

ul.li: Calm 3-Zone HeaderBar: Consolidates webcam shape and countdown into a progressive-disclosure popover and moves Preferences and About into the standard primary menu.
Expanded Preview Stage: Replaces the permanent top banner with a subtle centered empty-state guide and adds a clear Select Source transport button.
Viewfinder & Preferences Polish: Fixes OSD badge contrast, updates the developer name to Antonio De Gaetano, and adds AppStream screenshots for FlatPark and software centers.

description.p: Release v0.1.3 fixes webcam device detection, PipeWire file descriptor leaks, window lifecycle cleanup, and Preferences UI rendering:

ul.li: Security and Validation: Validates V4L2 device paths and output paths before building GStreamer pipelines.
Lifecycle and Leak Fixes: Cleans up timers, preview feeds, and active recording pipelines on window close, and eliminates cloned PipeWire file descriptor leaks.
UI/UX Fixes: Fixes Pango markup escaping in Preferences, prevents duplicate custom countdown dialogs, and ellipsizes long status paths in the bottom bar.

description.p: Added countdown timer option before recording (3s, 5s, 10s, or custom up to 5 minutes) and preserved webcam frame and live view framing in recorded videos.
Fix crash on recording trigger by resolving PipeWire socket contention and V4L2 device conflicts.
Initial release of RecGo with GPU acceleration, live camera preview, viewfinder OSD, and Preferences dialog.
